hook: OpenAI preprint disproves the polynomial Hirsch conjecture
hookText: OpenAI preprint disproves the polynomial Hirsch conjecture

beats.say: An OpenAI preprint constructs simple polytopes with n facets whose graph diameter grows faster than any fixed power of n, refuting the polynomial Hirsch conjecture.

The paper, dated November 24, shows that for every sufficiently large facet count there is a bounded simple rational polytope of subpolynomial dimension whose vertex graph has superpolynomial diameter.
The repository includes the Lean statements for the refutation and the paper's two main theorems.
